== Summary ==
Slip “Not Within Sight Or Reach” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 1230, 1624, 1953)). Version [[Not Within Sight Or Reach]] (Original). Not a recreation.
